mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate of 0.3 percentage points or more signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) of 2% or more signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index of 0.5% or more signals stronger manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls of 100,000 or more signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate of 0.25 percentage points or more signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent tightening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) of 5,000 units or more signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index of 0.4% or more signals accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 recent inflationary episodes.
